title: Polynomial-Time Bounded-Error Recognition
statement: Let $L$ be a language of bit strings. If there is a polynomial-time verifier that, on an input string and a uniformly random bit string of polynomial length, accepts with probability at least $2/3$ on inputs in $L$ and rejects with probability at least $2/3$ on inputs outside $L$, then $L$ belongs to $	extsf{BPP}_{m PTM}$.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a language of bit strings
The number of random bits is $a(n+1)^k$ for some natural numbers $a,k$
Acceptance probability is at least $2/3$ for members
Rejection probability is at least $2/3$ for nonmembers
